name: luckyplans-solana-perps-backfill-poc
description: SQD Portal backfill-only GMTrade and Jupiter Perps event indexing, canonical trade history, Parquet archive, and leaderboard proof of concept for LuckyPlans.

scripts.serve: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js serve
scripts.markets:sync: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js markets-sync --platform ALL --force
scripts.leaderboard:rebuild: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js leaderboard-rebuild
scripts.parquet:export: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js parquet-export
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning --test test/*.test.js
scripts.backfill:jupiter: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js backfill --platform JUPITER
scripts.backfill:gmtrade: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning dist/cli.js backfill --platform GMTRADE
